comment: The text uses “owns” and “stewards” when describing data responsibilities but does not define ownership, custodianship, stewardship, accountability, and source authority. These terms can have different legal meanings across countries.

anchor.note: p.56 l.Lines 340-346 read as the printed page; section 3.4.4 agrees

public.text: The text uses “owns” and “stewards” when describing data responsibilities but does not define ownership, custodianship, stewardship, accountability, and source authority. These terms can have different legal meanings across countries.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a responsibility model defining authoritative source, accountable authority, custodian, steward, processor or operator, and data contributor. Use these terms consistently across all component descriptions.
